If you have a preferred day/time or a length in mind, tell me and I'll work to that.

Heads-up: Professor Alvarez's assistant wrote asking for your availability next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) for a meeting, and whether we want anything added to the professor's calendar.

I offered only the genuinely free windows and said I'd check with you before moving anything: Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30 (Thu and Fri are full 09:00–17:00). I asked him for the length and first/second choice.

When he comes back with a slot I'll tell you before I accept. Say the word if you'd rather I hold a different window or reply differently.

Those windows look right to me — mornings before 10:00 on Wednesday and Monday after the advisor slot are my only real gaps. Check with me before you accept a slot, and nothing needs adding to Professor Alvarez's calendar for now. Thanks for asking him for the length first.

Noted — I'll check with you before accepting anything, and I won't add anything to the professor's calendar.

One thing to flag: Wednesday **09:00–10:00** is a CSE444 lecture in your calendar, so "before 10:00" isn't actually free — the Wednesday gap I offered him is **10:00–10:30** (right after that lecture, before the CSE452 lecture) or **13:00–13:30**. If you meant 10:00–10:30, say so and I'll steer him there; otherwise Monday 14:00–14:30 stands as the first choice.
You're right, my mistake — Wednesday morning is the CSE444 lecture. The 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30 gaps are the ones I meant. Monday 14:00–14:30 stays my first choice.

Status: six TAs have answered (John, Sarah, Omar, Hana, Priya, Diego). Everyone's week is packed and only 30-minute gaps exist; Thursday and Friday are fully booked for all of them. Two windows fit all six *and* your own calendar:

- **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30** (your free gap between Grant writing and the Research meeting)
- **Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** (between Thesis committee and Grant writing)

I'm waiting on Mara's availability; once she answers I'll book one of these and log it in CALENDAR.md.

One hour is right. No strong preference on the day — use my calendar as it stands and the department's schedule, and pick what works for all seven of them, so long as it stays clear of the CSE455 lectures and office hours. Send me the slot before you put it in the calendar.
Sent him your order: Mon 14:00–14:30 first, then Wed 10:00–10:30, then Wed 13:00–13:30, Tuesday as fallback — with the Wednesday correction. I'll bring you his chosen slot before I accept it.

I'd rather keep the hour if there's any way to get it — ask whether one of them could shift something, and check Mara's answer first. If a full hour truly isn't possible, the Wednesday 10:00 slot is my preference over Tuesday.
